title: Mean arterial pressure by gestational-age band and postnatal hours — KR 912_1

source.title: Среднее артериальное давление у новорожденных в зависимости от срока гестации и постконцептуального возраста

reviewNotes: The current recommendation presents this as a reference appendix table; this artifact does not reinterpret a table value as an autonomous hypotension-treatment trigger.
Values are grouped by gestational-age bands and postnatal hours exactly as the source table structure.
Clinical blood-pressure interpretation still depends on perfusion, measurement method, illness, medications and the full recommendation.
Runtime use requires clinician review of whether these values represent expected means, action thresholds, or a specific source cohort's summary.
